[warmly] Hello E2E Driver! It sounds like you’re introducing the concept of fractions to your students in a very interactive and relatable way. I love how you started by showing a circle and asking them to identify parts, making the abstract idea concrete with visual parts and colors. Using everyday examples like cutting a cake is excellent because it connects math to real life, helping students understand why fractions matter. 

You also engaged them by asking questions about numbers on tests, which deepens their understanding of parts and wholes. A little suggestion: try to reinforce the vocabulary clearly—like defining “fraction” as a part of a whole—and maybe summarize each step to ensure everyone follows along. Overall, your lesson is warm, inclusive, and hands-on, which is fantastic for young learners grasping new concepts. Keep up the great work! [encouragingly] If you want, I can help you plan some follow-up activities or visuals to make fractions even more fun and clear!
